name: colai
description: Point at anything on screen and hand it to an agent.

cliCommands.name: colai
cliCommands.description: Show the colai toolbar, or put it away

autostart.description: Open the toolbar when OpenClaw starts. On by default.

hotkey.description: The keys that bring the toolbar up from anywhere, for example "Ctrl+Alt+Space" (the default) or "Ctrl+Shift+M".
